invented.quote: A new 5-year lease starting at $5,000 a month
invented.why: The brief states the tenant can pay $5,100 a month, not $5,000.

invented.quote: 3% increases each year after the first, which brings the rent to about $5,630 in year five
invented.why: A 3% annual increase for four years does not equal $5,630 (from $5,100 it is about $5,740, and even from $5,000 it is about $5,628).
